_about: Hand English for JP-only Equips V2 names and lines Global has no text for (tools/build_equipsv2_en.py reads it). Seeded best-effort: katakana read as loanwords, kanji prefixes translated. Fix any wrong names; _review lists the uncertain ones (collab / coined readings). Keys starting with _ are ignored by the builder.

覇気に満ちた赤色が特徴の腰用装備。自らが飛竜となったかのように、力が湧いてくる。: Waist armor marked by a commanding red. Power wells up as if you had become a wyvern yourself.
特殊な技術と獰猛化素材によりあらたな性能を発揮した、リオレイアの頭用装備。: Rathian head armor that gains new performance from special techniques and Hyper materials.

金雷公の素材を用いた片手剣。この武器を用いる者は、より狩技ゲージが溜まりやすい。: A Sword & Shield made from Thunderlord materials. Its wielder fills the Hunter Arts gauge faster.
軍神と謳われた士が遺した雅なる刀。有明の如き麗しさをたたえた刃が阻む者を斬る。: An elegant katana left by a warrior hailed as a god of war. Its blade, lovely as the dawn moon, cuts down all who stand in the way.
炎龍の力を秘めた紅蓮の大剣。気品ある姿とは裏腹に、一度振れば四方一里は焦土と化す: A crimson great sword holding the power of a Flame Dragon. Despite its noble look, one swing turns everything for a league around into scorched earth.
雌火竜の甲殻をフレームに利用した深緑色の猟弓。美しくしなる姿は女王の肢体のよう。: A deep-green hunting bow framed with Rathian shell. Its graceful bend is like the body of a queen.
火竜の端材を用いたオトモ用の大剣。斬撃時にリオレウスのブレス同様の火炎が噴き出る: A Palico great sword made from Rathalos scraps. Each slash spouts flames like a Rathalos's breath.
ルドに支給された掃除屋の制服。: The Cleaners' uniform issued to Rudo.
エンジンの着ている掃除屋の制服。ロングコートタイプ。: The Cleaners' uniform Enjin wears. Long-coat type.
ザンカの着ている掃除屋の制服。ザンカの地元の民族衣装に合わせたアレンジが加えられ: The Cleaners' uniform Zanka wears, adapted to the traditional dress of his hometown.
リヨウの着ている掃除屋の制服。へそ出しで、露出度高め。: The Cleaners' uniform Riyo wears. It bares her midriff and shows a lot of skin.
